nvitk.segmentation.total_segmentator.cli¶

Dedicated nvitk-totalseg CLI for the TotalSegmentator integration.

Runs either locally (thin wrapper over run_totalsegmentator()) or on an SGE cluster via qsub + singularity exec (PESA-Fat style), optionally emitting a bash script and running it over SSH.
